name: Manufacture Order Edit Restriction
description:
The Manufacture Order Edit Restriction app provides administrators with the ability to prevent users from editing manufacturing orders in Odoo. By setting role-based restrictions, only users with the appropriate permissions can modify manufacturing orders, which ensures that critical production data is kept intact and unauthorized changes are prevented.

        Key Features:
        1) Role-Based User Restrictions:
           - Admin users can restrict editing rights for specific users to protect the integrity of manufacturing orders.

        2) Error Notifications for Restricted Users:
           - Users who are not authorized to edit manufacturing orders will receive a notification when attempting to make changes.

        Use Cases:
        - Limit the ability to edit manufacturing orders to specific users or roles.
        - Enhance security and accountability within manufacturing processes by preventing unauthorized modifications.

        Supported Views:
        - Navigation: Settings ➡ Users & Companies ➡ Users

description:
The Manufacture Order Creation Restriction app allows administrators to control who can create manufacturing orders in Odoo. By activating a specific setting, users with admin rights can restrict other users from creating manufacturing orders, ensuring that only authorized personnel can initiate the manufacturing process.

        Key Features:
        1) User-Specific Restrictions:
           - Admin users can enable restrictions for specific users, preventing unauthorized order creation.

        2) Pop-up Warning for Restricted Users:
           - Users who are restricted from creating manufacture orders will receive a warning message when attempting to create one.

        Use Cases:
        - Prevent unauthorized personnel from initiating manufacturing processes.
        - Manage access and control over production activities to maintain workflow security and integrity.

        Supported Views:
        - Navigation: Users ➡ Users & Companies ➡ Users
